description: ReplicationControllerCondition describes the state of a replication controller at a certain point.

lastTransitionTime.description: Time is a wrapper around time.Time which supports correct marshaling to YAML and JSON.  Wrappers are provided for many of the factory methods that the time package offers.

message.description: message is a human readable message indicating details about the transition.

reason.description: reason is the reason for the condition's last transition.

status.description: status of the condition, one of True, False, Unknown.

type.description: type is the type of replication controller condition.
